request: Add a camel_to_snake helper to the code generator and use it wherever names are converted.

summary.result_text:
I added `camel_to_snake` to `lnbits/helpers.py` and pointed the other camel-to-snake converter at it. I haven't run any tests: the pytest command (`test_helpers.py`, the Makefile `test-unit` env vars) needed an approval I didn't get, so none of this is verified.

- **Missing helper:** `camel_to_snake` was imported in `lnbits/core/models/extensions_builder.py`, `lnbits/core/services/extensions_builder.py` and `tests/unit/test_helpers.py`, but never defined. It now is: `re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1_\2", name).lower()`. That should turn `CamelCaseName` into `camel_case_name`, as the existing test expects.
- **Duplicate converter:** `_to_snake` in `lnbits/core/wasm_ext/api/runtime.py` now calls `camel_to_snake(value.replace("-", "_"))`. It does the same conversion as before. I also added the `lnbits.helpers` import and dropped the `re` import, which that file no longer uses.
- **Not changed:** `tools/codegen/extension_sdk_typescript.py` only converts snake to camel (`_camel`), so there was nothing to swap there. I also left `_camel_to_kebab` in `lnbits/core/wasm_ext/wasm/host.py` alone because it produces kebab-case, not snake_case.

Files touched: `lnbits/helpers.py` and `lnbits/core/wasm_ext/api/runtime.py`.

To check it, run the `make test-unit` target. I haven't looked at what it runs, so you may want to run `tests/unit/test_helpers.py` directly.
